exposure: CSP type (I, II, III) according to the Chinese Expert’s Consensus (2016)
CSP type Ia, Ib, IIa, IIb, IIIa, IIIb
cohort: Patients diagnosed with CSP at Shandong Provincial Hospital between January 2009 and December 2019
finding: The success rate of different treatments for CSP varied depending on the type of CSP, with dilation and curettage (D&C) being highly successful for type I, hysteroscopic curettage (H+C) being suitable for type II, and laparoscopy combined with H+C (L+H+C) being optimal for type III.
